user.title: Connect to the WattMosaic engine
user.description:
Enter the address of the WattMosaic engine. The engine performs all inference and learning; this integration only reads its results.

Stored API token: {token_status}.

data_description.api_token: Sent as the X-API-Token header. Leave empty if the engine has no token configured.

hassio_confirm.title: WattMosaic App found

settings.title: Polling and freshness
settings.description: How often the integration polls the engine, and when data is considered stale or unavailable. The engine currently reports {endpoint_count} endpoint(s).

data_description.stale_after: Results older than this are not published as current measurements. Default 120 s.
data_description.unavailable_after: The engine is treated as offline after this long without a successful poll. Default 120 s.

endpoints.title: Declare measurement endpoints

done.title: Save endpoint declarations
done.description: Writing {write_count} user declaration(s) to the engine.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure WattMosaic
reconfigure.description:
Update the engine connection. Leave the token empty to keep the current one.

Stored API token: {token_status}.

data_description.api_token: Leave empty to keep the stored token. The current token is never shown.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the engine. Check the URL, that the engine is running, and that Home Assistant can reach it.
error.invalid_auth: The engine rejected the API token.
error.contract_mismatch: The engine speaks an incompatible API contract version. Update the integration or the engine.
error.invalid_response: The engine returned a response that could not be understood.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while contacting the engine.
error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
error.invalid_token: The API token must be text.
error.out_of_range: The value is outside the allowed range.
error.stale_below_interval: Stale after must be greater than or equal to the scan interval.
error.unavailable_below_stale: Unavailable after must be greater than or equal to stale after.
error.invalid_mapping: The CT assignment is inconsistent. Check pairing, role and device.
error.no_channels: The engine reported no CT channels. Configure the engine topology first.
error.cannot_fetch_topology: Could not fetch the topology from the engine.
error.mapping_failed: The engine rejected the topology update.

abort.already_configured: This WattMosaic engine is already configured.
abort.not_configured: The WattMosaic entry is not configured.

init.description: Adjust polling and freshness thresholds. The engine currently reports {endpoint_count} endpoint(s).

start_learning.name: Start learning
start_learning.description: Enable active learning in the engine. Read-only toward devices.

pause_learning.name: Pause learning
pause_learning.description: Pause the learning pipeline without discarding collected samples.

accept_sample.name: Accept learning sample
accept_sample.description: Accept one rejected or pending learning sample.

reject_sample.name: Reject learning sample
reject_sample.description: Permanently reject one learning sample. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. Rejection is destructive.

rebuild_model.name: Rebuild model
rebuild_model.description: Retrain the active model for one device from stored samples.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device whose model should be rebuilt.

freeze_model.name: Freeze model
freeze_model.description: Freeze the active model so learning cannot replace it.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device whose model should be frozen.

unfreeze_model.name: Unfreeze model
unfreeze_model.description: Allow a frozen model to be replaced by future learning.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device whose model should be unfrozen.

reset_device_model.name: Reset device model
reset_device_model.description: Delete all learned models for one device. Requires confirm: true.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device whose models should be deleted.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. This cannot be undone.

rebuild_topology.name: Rebuild topology
rebuild_topology.description: Ask the engine to recompute topology candidates. Requires confirm: true. Produces candidates only.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Optional device to scope the rebuild to.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true. Existing candidate assignments are discarded.

run_diagnostics.name: Run diagnostics
run_diagnostics.description: Run engine diagnostics and return the report as a service response.

export_device_data.name: Export device data
export_device_data.description: Export stored raw and inferred data for one device as a service response.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: Optional export options passed to the engine.

discover_placements.name: Discover device placements
discover_placements.description: Learn which fixtures sit on which CT row from recorded history. Analysis is read-only; apply: true creates the devices and requires confirm: true. Rows measured as one device, and devices you configured yourself, are never changed.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true when apply is true.

engine_ambiguous.message: Several WattMosaic engines are configured; specify a device_id to choose one.

ambiguous_target.message: The target device belongs to more than one WattMosaic engine. Use the fully qualified '<config_entry_id>_<engine_device_id>' or pick the Home Assistant device instead.

unknown_target.message: The target device is not owned by any WattMosaic engine.

state.tier_3_measured: Measured — CT row or corroborated share
